title: Daayra – Kareena Kapoor, Prithviraj, Meghna Gulzar Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for Daayra – Kareena Kapoor, Prithviraj, Meghna Gulzar — premieres Nov 13, 2026.
body:
• The trailer for Daayra – Kareena Kapoor, Prithviraj, Meghna Gulzar dropped November 12, 2026.
  • New movie premiering Nov 13, 2026 on Netflix India.
  • Protocol versus punishment. Jung chhid chuki hain, kiski hogi jeet?

The makers of Daayra – Kareena Kapoor, Prithviraj, Meghna Gulzar have released the official trailer, unveiled November 12, 2026.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
